lede: President Donald J. Trump's latest filing, posted by OGE on Aug. 22, added 1,051 trades dated June 1 to June 29, 2026, comprising 576 purchases and 475 sales, with 694 flagged as filed late. The disclosure brings his tracked total to 8,940 transactions between January 2025 and June 29, 2026, of which 7,137, or 80 percent, were flagged as filed late; the trades concentrate in March 2026, which accounts for 2,349 transactions. Separately, Office of Personnel Management Director Scott A. Kupor's two filings, posted Aug. 21, report five July 2026 sales totaling between $3.6 million and $16.3 million, including two Okta sales the filing attributes to the exercise of covered call options, along with sales of Robinhood, Omada and Samsara stock.
